name: What are common signs that my roof needs repair or replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my roof needs repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your roof needs attention include missing, cracked, or curled shingles, dark stains or moss growth, granules in your gutters, and leaks or water stains on your ceilings. A sagging roof deck or a noticeable increase in your energy bills can also indicate underlying issues. Promptly addressing these signs can prevent more extensive and costly damage to your home's structure and interior.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include damaged shingles, leaks, water stains, sagging, or granules in gutters.
